title: Chapter 357 Eternal Peace For The Human Race
content:
Chapter 357 Eternal Peace For The Human Race

Then, he poured out his lifelong power and finally forcibly broke free from Lu Daosheng's space constraints.

But this also cost him a huge price.

The whole body became bloody, and the strange runes all over his body became dull.

Even so, his speed did not slow down at all, galloping towards the distance at an indescribable speed.

The starry sky that passed by left a scratch that could not heal for a long time.

However, what Lu Daosheng said naturally has no reason to take it back.

Seeing the creature escaping, Lu Daosheng was calm and a large eagle bow appeared out of thin air in his hand. The bow was not stringed. Lu Daosheng pulled his empty hand and a dazzling arrow appeared out of thin air.

I heard the space tremble and the lightning flashed.

The creature that was far away billions of miles away turned into a blood mist, and there was no life in the ten dead.

In place, Lu Daosheng gently put away the large eagle bow in his hand, stood with his hands behind his back, his calm eyes swept to the end of the starry sky, and said lightly: "At present, the body still dares not show up. Is this the so-called god? ”

Lu Daosheng's voice was not loud, but it was extremely penetrating.

The starry sky calmed for a moment, and the next moment, the familiar voice came.

"Do you really want to be an enemy of this God?"

This time, there seemed to be a sense of negotiation in this sound.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng couldn't help but sneer.

"Are you worthy of being an enemy of you?"

These words are extremely arrogant, and even the gods who have been in high positions for a long time can't help but be stunned for a long time.

This was the first time he had encountered such a tough existence.

Then, anger surged from the bottom of my heart.

"Okay, okay."

Four good words in a row all show his anger at this moment.

"No matter who you are, I advise you not to come to the land of the gods, otherwise you will be responsible for the consequences."

After saying this, the breath of the god disappeared into the starry sky.

The land of the gods?

Lu Daosheng's mouth raised slightly, showing a very dangerous smile.

If you don't let me go, I still insist on going.

You should call yourself a god, right? You'd better be a god, so that you can give me a little more fun.

However, he has not planned to pay attention to the so-called god yet.

What he wants to do now is to get familiar with this new world first.

Now he is much better than before.

At the same time, he also understood why no matter how he upgraded, he would never touch the new world.

The direction is all wrong, not something that ordinary way to become stronger can be achieved.

It's like a comparison between two-dimensional and three-dimensional.

Only by jumping out of the original world can you truly find a new world.

The God in the Blue Star gave Lu Daosheng a chance.

Without thinking about it, Lu Daosheng began to head towards a dazzling star in the starry sky.

I don’t know how long it took, a huge world appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

The world is extremely huge, with a capacity that can almost reach tens of thousands of starry skyscrapers.

And on the periphery of this world, there is a transparent shield that seems to be guarding this world.

Lu Daosheng did not say anything low-key about this, and directly punched him.

It was accompanied by a terrifying roar.

The whole world trembled, and countless creatures looked horrified and suddenly looked into the void.

I saw that the originally calm void suddenly broke a hideous gap, and then, in the endless chaos, a human man in a robe slowly walked out of it.

His face is calm, giving people a feeling of spring breeze.

But even such a man is surrounded by an extremely terrifying aura, with the great way of heaven accompanying him, and endless laws paving the way for him.

What exactly does this exist? !

For a moment, the sentient beings looked different.

Countless strong men were uneasy.

And the most exciting thing is the human creatures in this world.

"Hahaha, my human race is worry-free!!"

"That's my human power, my human power!"

"The Human Emperor appears, the Human Emperor appears!!"

Countless human races burst into tears and were filled with joy.

This made the other living creatures look a little ugly.

"Hmph, let's not talk about whether he is a real human powerhouse. Even so, why do you think that the other party will protect your human race? Don't be too beautiful."

Soon, creatures spoke mocking.

These words immediately caused the sentient beings to nod.

Although the human race is not very weak in this world, it is definitely not strong. Recently, with the fall of a strong man in the human race, the human race is directly bullied by race and is facing the disaster of extermination.

Now a strong man suddenly appeared in the human race and fell from the sky, and his majesty was so high that he would not make the remaining human race excited.

These words undoubtedly remind the powerful people of the human race.

For a moment, everyone looked at the man in the robe in the void again.

Next, we need to see the purpose of this human race coming to this world.

Once they are different from what they think, then the human race will really face a desperate situation.

"Your Excellency, you,"

At this moment, a creature appeared in the void and faced the man in the robe from afar.

As soon as he appeared, Lu Daosheng set his sight on him.

I saw that this creature was exactly the same as the human leader, but its pupils were golden, and its body structure was completely different from that of humans.

Originally, Lu Daosheng did not have any racial discrimination at the beginning.

But along the way, he encountered too many other races.

Most of these races seem to discriminate against the human race, especially those powerful races. When they see that the human race is weak, they begin to kill the human race on a large scale.

The human race takes the human emperor as its belief.

It can be clearly seen from the world of all spirits.

But no one knows where the Human Emperor is.

Even Lu Daosheng has never seen him even now.

Human Emperor, if you are here, why can't you protect the human race?

Lu Daosheng closed his eyes slightly, thinking about something in his heart.

In the distance, the golden-eyed creature looked at Lu Daosheng without saying anything, and did not move anyway, which made him very puzzled.

"Your Excellency, what's the matter with you coming to this world?"

However, Lu Daosheng still ignored him.

Buzz —

At this time, a powerful spiritual sense suddenly surged out of Lu Daosheng's body, and then directly covered the entire world with powerful resources.

There is no place where a creature can escape Lu Daosheng's spiritual consciousness.

"Your Excellency, you!"

The golden-eyed creature looked shocked, and looked at Lu Daosheng with a hint of fear in his eyes.

At this time, Lu Daosheng had already opened his eyes.

There was a hint of fatigue in his eyes.

He has already seen the situation in this world clearly.

"Is it purpose,"

Lu Daosheng murmured in his mouth.

At this moment, he thought of his daughter.

In the Human Emperor Hall, she obtained the inheritance of the Human Emperor Hall and obtained the Xuanyuan Sword.

Now that I think about it, although the Human Emperor Palace in the Ten Thousand Spirit Realm is not the Human Emperor Palace in the true sense, it definitely has traces of the Real Human Emperor.

His daughter, Kong Renren, passed on the inheritance of the emperor, did not actually do anything that would truly benefit the human race.

Thinking of this, Lu Daosheng looked at the world below.

To be immersed in the goal is the human race’s desire.

Lu Daosheng was silent for a moment and slowly spoke, "Here we come, we will protect the human race from peace forever."
